name: Docker Metadata action
description: GitHub Action to extract metadata (tags, labels) for Docker

context.description: Where to get context data. Allowed options are "workflow"  (default), "git".

images.description: List of Docker images to use as base name for tags

tags.description: List of tags as key-value pair attributes

sep-tags.description: Separator to use for tags output (default \n)

sep-labels.description: Separator to use for labels output (default \n)

github-token.description: GitHub Token as provided by secrets
